text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Monday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Union of Christian Democrats decided to stay in the cabinet led by Prime Minister Andris Shkele. The decision was taken last Saturday by 23 votes against two.
- Interior Minister Dainis Turlais has proposed amendments on laws which protect women and children against sexual abuse. He noted that Latvia had become a sex business transit state.
- 10 insurance companies will create a pool to insure carriers transporting dangerous cargos.
- Last week Latvia was visited by representatives of international rating agency Standard & Poors, which will draw up a credit rating for Latvia.
- A working group in the ministry of economics is finishing a programme for developing small and medium-sized businesses.
- Latvian farms must be over 100 hectares to have any future potential and at least 30 hectares to survive, experts from the ministry of agriculture have concluded.
